articles.title: Adam Back's BSTR scraps SPAC merger, seeks new deal
articles.snippet: BSTR and Cantor Equity Partners will not complete their merger under the original July 2025 agreement, with the shareholder postponed indefinitely.

articles.title: SpaceX's first bitcoin wallet movements in six months likely don't signal sales
articles.snippet: Onchain trackers found the newly public company shifted a tiny amount of bitcoin between its own addresses. Nothing reached an exchange.

articles.title: BlackRock-backed Securitize slides 40% after SPAC debut despite tokenization boom
articles.snippet: The decline fits into a pattern of recently-public digital asset companies sliding after debut, Arca's Jeff Dorman said.

articles.title: Analysts see more upside for SpaceX as post-IPO research begins
articles.snippet: Major brokerages initiated coverage on Tuesday with mostly buy ratings following the company's $75 billion June IPO.

articles.title: AI trade loses steam as infrastructure boom faces reality check
articles.snippet: Record earnings, rising competition and concerns over slowing AI spending are forcing investors to reassess one of the market's biggest trades.
